title: Relation to child labor law.
bodyText: Nothing in this chapter shall in any way repeal or affect the validity of chapter 390.
bodyHtml: §387-15  Relation to child labor law.  Nothing in this chapter shall in any way repeal or affect the validity of chapter 390. [L Sp 1941, c 66, §15; RL 1945, §4366; RL 1955, §94-16; HRS §387-15; am L 1980, c 232, §22]
